title: Orunmila session verdict, schema version 1
description: The whole session's one verdict, the last line a judgement writes to the verdict log: Incomplete if any evidence was lost, otherwise the most serious verdict among its events.
$comment: brief v4 line 686; Q34, approved by O 2026-11-24 (LD262). Unknown fields are allowed (brief v4 line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as the session's verdict.

seq.description: The record's place in the verdict log.

verdict_id.description: The session verdict's id, numbered with the log's verdicts.

verdict.description: incomplete, clean, look_at_this or violation. Incomplete outranks Clean, always.

reasons.description: Each reason the session is Incomplete, empty when it is not: a gap (a source lost events: the gap odùs), the law gate silent, or the Glove silent (the Sentinel's odùs inside the project it said nothing about).

odu_ids.description: The odùs that show it, in order; empty for the law gate silent, which is shown by none.

counts.description: How many odùs got each verdict, and how many of them the default view hides.
counts.$comment: agent's choice, Q34 (the report gives the counts, brief v4 line 690)

hidden.description: Of them, those the default view hides.

law_gate.description: The law gate's checks over the session, from each odù's law_gate witness: how many turns it checked, how many passed, warned, were blocked and were skipped, the skip rate (skipped over checked, a whole percent), and whether that rate is over the 2% ceiling. Skips are a count, never Incomplete. Absent in a judgement from before the law gate's results were in the odù record.
law_gate.$comment: brief v4 lines 686, 692; approved by O as Q40 (2026-11-24, LD267, LD284)

blocked.description: Checks that blocked the turn; each is its own finding (R21).

skip_rate.description: Skipped over checked, as a whole percent, 0 when none was checked.

over_ceiling.description: True when the skip rate is over 2%: its own Look at this (R22).

judged.description: The odù log's last line this judgement read, by seq and hash.

judge.description: The judge that gave this verdict: its name and version.

rules.description: The fingerprint of the rule set that judged it.

rules_source.description: Where the rules came from: `header` (the rules file as it was at session start, kept in the session header), `default` (the session header holds none, so Orunmila's default rules), `file` (a re-judgement with a rules file named by the user).
rules_source.$comment: brief v4 lines 283, 664, 684; agent's choice, Q34

supersedes.description: null, or the earlier session verdict a later judgement replaces.
